main.description: A vouch on the Atlas of Care: this organisation or person holds my world together in this place. It lives in the voucher's repo, carries no text of their own, and is placed in an administrative unit, not at an address.

atlas.description: The atlas this vouch is for. The backlink index finds vouches by this field.

subject.description: Who is vouched for: an atproto account (a DID) or an http(s) address.

scope.description: Which of the atlas's maps the unit belongs to.

unit.description: The unit's id on that map.

lat.description: Latitude of the unit's centre, as a decimal string with two places.

lon.description: Longitude of the unit's centre, as a decimal string with two places.
